Listen [Listen](https://app-oc.readspeaker.com/cgi-bin/rsent?customerid=5525&lang=en_au&readid=content&readclass=lit-readspeaker-target&url=https%3A//www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/how-much-jobseeker-payment-you-can-get%3Fcontext%3D51411 "Listen to this page using ReadSpeaker") # How much you can get We pay JobSeeker Payment every 2 weeks. The amount you get depends on your circumstances. ## on this page - [Payment rates](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/how-much-jobseeker-payment-you-can-get?context=51411#a1) - [If you have dependent children](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/how-much-jobseeker-payment-you-can-get?context=51411#a2) - [If you pay or receive child support](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/how-much-jobseeker-payment-you-can-get?context=51411#a3) The amount of JobSeeker Payment you can get depends on all the following: - your age - if you have a partner - if you have dependent children - how much income you and your partner have been paid in the past 14 days. ## Payment rates The following table is a guide only of JobSeeker Payment amounts. We update rates on 20 March and 20 September each year. | Your situation | Your maximum fortnightly payment from 20 September 2026 | | --- | --- | | Single, no children | $824.90 | | Single, with a dependent child or children | $883.30 | | Single, 55 or older, after 9 continuous months on an income support payment | $883.30 | | Single, assessed as having a [partial capacity to work](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/if-you-have-reduced-capacity-to-work?context=51411#partial) of less than 15 hours a week | $883.30 | | Partnered | $755.10 | | Single principal carer granted an exemption from mutual obligation requirements for any of the following:
- foster caring
- non-parent relative caring under a court order
- home schooling
- distance education
- large family. | $1,068.20 | You can use the [Centrelink payment finder](https://www.centrelink.gov.au/apps/clkonline_cof/payment-service-finder/rate-estimator/income-detail) to check if you can get JobSeeker Payment and estimate your rate. JobSeeker Payment is a taxable Centrelink payment. You can ask us to [deduct tax from your payment](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/deduct-tax-from-your-payment?context=51411). This can help reduce the amount of tax you may have to pay at the end of the tax year. ## If you have dependent children If you get this payment and have a dependent child under 16, the rate you’ll get paid is single, with a dependent child or children. If you get this payment and your child turns 16 or 17, you may also get this rate. It’s important to tell us about any changes, read more about [change of circumstances](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/change-circumstances-when-you-get-jobseeker-payment?context=51411). ## If you pay or receive child support JobSeeker Payment may affect the amount of [child support](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/managing-child-support) you pay or receive. You need to tell us [if your income changes](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/change-circumstances-for-child-support?context=21911). [Income and assets tests\\ \\ You must meet the income and assets tests to get JobSeeker Payment.](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/income-and-assets-tests-for-jobseeker-payment?context=51411) [Paying tax on your payment\\ \\ You may have to pay income tax on your taxable Centrelink payments.](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/paying-tax-centrelink-payment?context=51411) ### How would you rate this page?
